gui_forms::ProgressBar.summary: ProgressBar is a noninteractive RangeControl visualization with continuous, segmented, and marquee modes; optional overlays and stripes; centralized motion-policy resolution; retained frame scheduling; deterministic phase; reduced-motion behavior; and progress semantics.
remarks: Noninteractive. Continuous, segmented, and marquee modes plus optional overlays and stripes are public library styles.

Motion is resolved through one centralized policy; the control becomes scheduler-quiescent when paused, disabled, or effectively hidden, and reduced motion stays visibly animated at the calmer public cadence.
Nonfocusable and hit-test transparent; publishes numeric or busy semantics.
gui_forms::ProgressBar.ownership: Created by the application as a `Control::Ptr` (`std::shared_ptr<Control>`). A parent holds its children strongly and a child holds its parent weakly; cycles, duplicate stable IDs, cross-window reparenting, and disposed children are rejected. Disposal through `Component::dispose()` is synchronous and idempotent and revokes owned subscriptions before subclass teardown.
gui_forms::ProgressBar.threading: UI-thread affine. Read and mutate on the owning Window's UI thread; wrong-thread mutation is rejected by the Window access guards (`Window::check_access` and `Window::verify_access`). The type is not internally synchronized.
gui_forms::ProgressBar.availability: Renderer-neutral core (`gui_forms_controls`). Available wherever the GUI.Forms core builds: the macOS AppKit host, the Windows Win32 host, and the opt-in Linux X11 host. The public API is not yet stable.
